title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Hunters scatter in the savannah during a collective hunt in the forest of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In most of Central Africa, traditional hunting practices are being replaced by metal snares, guns and night hunting, impacting wildlife populations and the livelihoods of rural communities. Photo by: Katinka Wendt, LKBP/CASCB
